question: 56 years ago today, Tom Dempsey kicked a 63-yard field goal, an NFL record. How many years passed before anyone kicked one longer?
question_short: Tom Dempsey's 63-yard kick set the NFL record in 1970. How long until someone beat it?
answer_detail: Broncos kicker Matt Prater finally did it in Denver on Dec. 8, 2013, with a 64-yarder against Tennessee as the first half ended. Broncos great Jason Elam had only tied the 63-yard mark, back in 1998.
answer_short: Broncos kicker Matt Prater hit a 64-yarder in Denver in December 2013.
